newsitem.title: INDIA: India government bonds rally, t-bill yields down.
newsitem.headline: India government bonds rally, t-bill yields down.

text.p: Prices of government securities continued to climb on Thursday while yields on treasury bills fell marginally, dealers said.
"The market is still bullish," Somesh Mithi, dealer at Lloyds Brokerage said. He said prices on government securities rallied by 15-20 paise across all maturities.

The 13.62 percent 1998 stock rose by 30 basis points to 103.20/25 rupees, up from the Wednesday's closing levels, while the 13.50 percent 1998 stock rose to 102.20/25 rupees, up from Wednesday's 101.85/90 rupees, Mithi added.
The price rise began on the eve of Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy announced on October 19, which increased liquidity in the banking system and prompted lending rate cuts.
